==Description==
'''Moon Walk''' is an emote obtained from the [[Hexscape Event#Hexscape Event Battle Pass|Hexscape Event Battle Pass]]. It was made by Mewious and STEALTH_NOVA. The emote is looped and no music can be heard while performing the emote. Players can move while performing the emote but it cannot be interacted with. Players gain a fedora while performing the emote.

This emote could be obtained at Level 25 of the premium track, where it costed {{CandyCorns|820 Candy Corns}} or {{Robux|80}} ({{Robux|60}} for the Black Friday 2024 Sale) to unlock. It had a total cost of {{CandyCorns|9,810 Candy Corns}} or {{Robux|1,900}} ({{Robux|1,429}} for the Black Friday 2024 Sale).

==Trivia==
*'''Moon Walk''' is a reference to the [[wp:Moonwalk (dance)|moonwalk]], a dance move popularized by [[wp:Michael Jackson|Michael Jackson]].
